global_style: An artistic, Morandi-inspired deck utilizing a persistent complex organic background offset by strict, solid-color rectangular content overlays.

identity_anchors: Full-bleed complex, organic background acting as a continuous canvas
Solid-color, sharp-edged rectangular floating cards defining the content area
Vertical accent blocks in top-left slide headers
Prominent, oversized serif typography for major titles and numbers

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
